review_candidates.title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About The Role Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team. The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out. We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it. That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country. There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business. As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include: Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership. Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development. Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands. Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers. Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on. Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers. Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny. Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets. Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud. Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers. Who You Are You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader. You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here. You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate. You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV. You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot. You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers. You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions. Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations. Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus. Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus. Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements. Cultural Alignment As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation. Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets. Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality. Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality. Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early. Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders. No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes. Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not. Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable. What Success Looks Like The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time. The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap. Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification. A native mobile experience shipped for field officers. Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves. The platform ready to support a new market. A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers. Why Join Us A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform. A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them. Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain. Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals. What To Expect In The Hiring Process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter. 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers. 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes. 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business. 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager). Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive organisation.

review_candidates.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title And Summary Director, Specialist Sales - SME About Mastercard Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry, connecting consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses in more than 210 countries and territories. Through secure, simple, and smart payment solutions, Mastercard enables digital commerce and economic growth worldwide. Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) are a critical engine of economic development in the UAE and globally, representing a significant share of employment and GDP. Enabling SME digitization, financial inclusion, and growth through innovative payment and distribution models remains a strategic priority for Mastercard. ________________________________________ About The Role Mastercard is seeking a commercially driven Director, SME Sales Specialist based in Dubai to drive SME growth and activation across the East Arabia region, including the UAE, GCC markets, and Pakistan. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, ecosystem development, and commercialization, with responsibility for converting strategic partnerships into measurable business outcomes. The focus is on driving end-to-end performance across opportunity identification, pipeline development, deal closure, partner activation, and sustained revenue generation. A key priority is ensuring that signed and launched partnerships translate into active, high-performing programs by driving card issuance, usage growth, and revenue realization. You will expand Mastercard’s SME footprint across banks, Payfacs, fintechs, marketplaces, telcos, ISV providers, trade platforms, logistics networks, and other embedded finance ecosystems in the UAE. The role requires strong market engagement and representation of Mastercard across industry forums, client discussions, and ecosystem partnerships, strengthening Mastercard’s leadership in SME payments and embedded finance. Working closely with Account Management, Business Development, SME Product teams, and Customer Solutions teams, you will develop business cases, shape go-to-market strategies, and ensure seamless execution from deal stage through activation and scale. This is a high-impact role requiring strong commercial ownership, execution discipline, and the ability to operate in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. ________________________________________ Key Responsibilities Own and execute a revenue-driven SME sales and activation strategy focused on emerging SME payment flows and partner-led distribution models. Drive activation, card issuance, usage growth, and revenue realization across SME programs in the UAE. Identify, prioritize, and convert high-potential opportunities across banks, fintechs, marketplaces, telcos, trade, logistics, and embedded ecosystem partners. Expand SME distribution through strategic partnerships, channel partners, and embedded payment flows. Build and manage a structured, data-driven activation pipeline focused on commercial impact and strategic relevance. Translate unmet SME needs into scalable, activation-ready commercial solutions. Collaborate with Account Management, Business Development, and Product teams to develop business cases, go-to-market strategies, and solution design. Ensure successful execution of partnerships from deal stage through activation, onboarding, and scale. Monitor industry trends, competitive dynamics, and regulatory developments to identify growth opportunities. Represent Mastercard in UAE industry forums, client engagements, and ecosystem partnerships. Partner with Customer Solutions Center and Product teams to support solution implementation and post-launch optimization. Develop activation playbooks, sales materials, workshops, and structured narratives to support SME commercialization. Ensure consistent SME messaging, execution discipline, and performance tracking across all programs. ________________________________________ All About You Proven experience in sales, business development, or partnerships with strong delivery of revenue growth and pipeline management. Strong track record of achievement in sales roles, including lead generation, deal negotiation, activation, and revenue delivery. Experience engaging both commercial and technical stakeholders to drive solution development and adoption. Deep understanding of payments, financial services, and digital distribution models, including industry trends and competitive dynamics. Strong relationship management, influencing, collaboration, and communication skills across senior stakeholders. Ability to operate independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver in fast-paced, matrixed global environments. Self-starter with strong execution discipline and ability to work with minimal guidance. Strong analytical thinking with ability to structure business cases, narratives, and executive presentations. Ability to work effectively in high-growth, complex, and evolving environments. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required. Experience in SME banking, SME payments, fintech, or consulting is highly desirable. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

You'll personally conduct and manage media relations as well as direct market-specific PR agencies outside the US, holding them to delivering coverage that advances our corporate initiatives. Internally, you'll build the path to the right coverage at the right time, opening new markets and creating opportunities for growth and awareness. You'll also partner with the global product teams to connect coverage and communications to product initiatives, launches, and growth, driving brand awareness and product engagement. You take initiative without waiting to be asked, and you're always looking for smarter ways to fold PR and communications into the broader marketing strategy. You understand the levers that shape market awareness and perception, you make complex ideas land, and you do your best work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Integrate PR and communications into existing marketing strategies, and pioneer new, innovative ways to engage each market from a PR and communications perspective. Accountable to region-specific marketing leads to integrate communications campaigns and strategies that align with their respective strategic remits. Partner with international spokespeople and regional teams to spot industry trends and establish thought leadership. Use byline articles and interviews to position our core messages and amplify customer stories across priority markets. Localize and coordinate the distribution of global announcements. Coordinate with PR agencies, as well as initiate outreach on your own, to win media placements in trade, general, and business press. Draft, monitor, and evaluate OKR (Objectives, Key Results) progress throughout the year. A proactive self-starter who consistently integrates PR and communications into existing marketing strategies and develops new, innovative ways to engage in market. Proven track record building and running communications programs across EMEA, Latin America, and Asia Pacific markets. Deep expertise across public relations, social media, and message development. Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across a highly matrixed organization and drive real business outcomes. Excellent communicator who conveys complex ideas and data clearly in writing and spoken for a range of audiences. Cross-functional leadership skills, with the judgment to set strategy and the willingness to execute when needed. Highly motivated and quick to adapt to changing market and organizational needs.
